name: Chip
purpose: Represents a compact selectable label for filters, categories, or short choices.
neverUseFor: Primary page actions — use Button instead
Long text labels — chips are compact by design
Destructive confirmation flows — use a Button pair instead

authored.name: checked
authored.description: The chip is currently checked or active in its group.

authored.name: dismissible
authored.description: Renders an additional close button (chip-dismiss) beside the chip, active only when both dismissible=true and onDismiss is provided.

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for the chip and optional dismiss button.
Close button that fires onDismiss. Rendered only when dismissible=true and onDismiss is provided.

props.name: size
props.description: Horizontal density preset. Chip is a documented exception to the global scale — default is 's', not 'm', a deliberate deviation from ADR-004's general 'm is the default' convention for this component specifically.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, passed by reference. Rendered via the Icon component at a fixed 14px.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Trailing icon. Same fixed 14px as icon.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button for removing the chip.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Dismiss handler fired from the close button.

height.note: Chip uses a local density model; this does not redefine the global scale. s = 24px (semantic.size.s, was 28px until 2026-10-01): same height as Badge s and the control ladder's s, and it sits 4px inside a 32px field (MultiSelect, ADR-019).

modes.hug: Width shrinks to fit label and icons.
modes.fixed: Explicit width set by the consumer.
